description: Tasmanian Gas Pipeline Easement and Planning Corridor is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Tasmania Government's The List Data. The easement dataset shows the extents of the gazetted easement granted to Tasmanian Gas Pipeline (TGP) Pty Ltd within which the high pressure TGP and associated utilities and facilities are located. No inference should be made as to the location of the gas pipeline itself based on the easement location and boundaries. Coverage: Tasmania. The portal files it under the publisher Tasmania Government's The List Data. Its tags are UTILITIES-Any. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support pipeline routing and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
